title: British Indian Ocean Territory Vehicle Freezer
script:
-- British Indian Ocean Territory Vehicle Freezer

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ScreenGui
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BritishIndianOceanTerritoryVehicleFreezer"
gui.Parent = playerGui
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Floating Icon
local icon = Instance.new("TextButton")
icon.Size = UDim2.new(0,60,0,60)
icon.Position = UDim2.new(0,20,0.5,-30)
icon.Text = "🇮🇴"
icon.TextScaled = true
icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
icon.Parent = gui
icon.Active = true
icon.Draggable = true

-- Main Frame
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,420,0,300)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-210,0.5,-150)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
frame.Visible = false
frame.Parent = gui
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

-- Title (Updated to Full Name)
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
title.Text = "British Indian Ocean Territory Vehicle Freezer"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Parent = frame

-- Home Page
local homePage = Instance.new("Frame")
homePage.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-30)
homePage.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,30)
homePage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
homePage.Parent = frame

-- Profile Icon
local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
avatar.Size = UDim2.new(0,70,0,70)
avatar.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,10)
avatar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
avatar.Parent = homePage

local thumbType = Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot
local thumbSize = Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100
local content = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, thumbType, thumbSize)
avatar.Image = content

-- Player Info
local info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
info.Size = UDim2.new(1,-90,0,120)
info.Position = UDim2.new(0,90,0,10)
info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
info.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
info.Text =
"Username: "..player.Name..
"\nUser ID: "..player.UserId..
"\nLocation: Brazil"..
"\nState: Stable"
info.Parent = homePage

-- Freeze Button
local freeze = Instance.new("TextButton")
freeze.Size = UDim2.new(0.4,0,0,40)
freeze.Position = UDim2.new(0.05,0,0.75,0)
freeze.Text = "Freeze Vehicles"
freeze.Parent = homePage

-- Unfreeze Button
local unfreeze = Instance.new("TextButton")
unfreeze.Size = UDim2.new(0.4,0,0,40)
unfreeze.Position = UDim2.new(0.55,0,0.75,0)
unfreeze.Text = "Unfreeze Vehicles"
unfreeze.Parent = homePage

-- Infinite Yield Button
local iyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
iyButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,40)
iyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05,0,0.9,0)
iyButton.Text = "Load Infinite Yield"
iyButton.Parent = homePage

iyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source"))()
end)

-- Toggle GUI
icon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
end)

-- Freeze Logic (Safe)
freeze.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
            local vehicleModel = v:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if vehicleModel then
                for _, p in pairs(vehicleModel:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        p.Anchored = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Unfreeze Logic (Safe)
unfreeze.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
            local vehicleModel = v:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if vehicleModel then
                for _, p in pairs(vehicleModel:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        p.Anchored = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
features: British Indian Ocean Territory Vehicle Freezer Is An Vehicle Freezer That Freeze Any Vehicles You want, and Unfreeze more!
